# Trip Report: Tokyo -> Kyoto -> Osaka
*For travelers with ordinary Colombian passports*

## 0. Validated Trip Specification (trip-spec)
- **Traveler Profile**: Colombian Ordinary | 1 Traveler(s) | Tourism
- **Origin**: Bogotá (BOG)
- **Places & Cities**: Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka
- **Dates & Duration**: 2026-11-05 to 2026-11-20 (15 days)
- **Preferred Weather**: Mild autumn, crisp, dry (fall foliage)
- **Lodging Criteria**: Type: hotel | Room: private_room | Bath: private_bathroom | Stars: 3 stars | Max: 80 USD

## 1. Feasibility & Entry Requirements (Cancillería)
- **Visa Status**: Consular Visa Required for ordinary Colombian passports
- **Permitted Stay**: Up to 90 days
- **Passport Validity**: Minimum 6 months validity required from departure date.
- **Health & Vaccines**: Travel medical insurance recommended.
- **Layovers & Transit**: Connections via US hubs require a US transit/tourist visa; connections via Madrid/Paris stay airside.
- **Official Source**: https://www.cancilleria.gov.co/politica-exterior/asuntos-bilaterales/asia/japon

## 2. Route & Interactive Map
- **Ordered Route**: Tokyo -> Kyoto -> Osaka
- **Google Maps Link**: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Tokyo&destination=Osaka&waypoints=Kyoto&travelmode=driving
- **Useful Map Searches**:
  - Tokyo station: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Tokyo+station

## 3. Flights & Connections from Colombia
- **Recommended Flight Corridor**: 1-stop from Bogotá (BOG) via Madrid or Paris to Tokyo.
- **Critical Layovers**: Avoid US layovers unless holding a valid US visa.

## 4. Budget & Price Estimates
- **Live Exchange Rate**: 1 USD = 4,180.00 COP (Source: ExchangeRate-API, fetched 2026-11-05)
- **Indicative Flights**: 1,350–1,950 USD round-trip
- **Accommodation (Booking / Airbnb)**: Filtered by SDD (`hotel`, `private_room`, `private_bathroom`, `3 stars`, cap <= 80 USD): Indicative range **52–80 USD / night** across Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka.

## 5. Sights, Culture & Local Food
- **Tokyo**: Senso-ji, Meiji Shrine, Shibuya.
- **Kyoto**: Fushimi Inari, Kinkaku-ji.
- **Osaka**: Dotonbori, Osaka Castle.

## 6. Logistics, Weather & Practical Tips
- **Weather & Packing**: Preferred weather: Mild autumn, crisp, dry (fall foliage). Pack light layers.
- **Local Transport & Pace**: Shinkansen between Tokyo, Kyoto, and Osaka; 5 days per stop.

## Assumptions & Caveats
- Verify live fares before booking.
